textRuns.value: Prerequisites: open this generated PBIP in Power BI Desktop, refresh the inline sample model, then save as PBIX. Field roles: Lines = StatementLines[SectionID] > [LineID], Period = Period[Period], values = Actual/Budget/Prior measures. Formatting, signs and variance behavior come from the line metadata setting. Use +/- only for delivered children; Shift+F10 or right-click opens the Power BI context menu and host-defined drillthrough when a destination page is configured.
